rows.wrong_if: Q4 2026 toplines (44-week body composition, 30-week T2D, SWITCH). We would cut if the T2D study shows weaker HbA1c than orforglipron or liver-enzyme signals.
QUELL-CV Ph2 12-week hsCRP topline (Q4 2026). We would cut if the hsCRP reduction falls below ~60% in patients.
AURORA Ph3 topline (Q1 2027). We would cut if the placebo-adjusted MG-ADL benefit is under 2 points.
End-of-Ph2 meetings and Ph3 starts (Q1 2027). We would cut if Ph3 cannot be funded without heavy dilution.
Rolling BLA completion (Q4 2026). We would cut if the BLA slips or FDA requests a randomized trial.
FDA decision (Nov 28 2026). We would cut on a CRL or if no US commercial partner is signed.
FDA decision Feb 28 2027. We would cut on a CRL, or on a label limited to CPAP-intolerant patients with a strong warning on cardiovascular effects.
FDA decision Mar 10 2027. We would cut on a CRL or a label requiring long-term follow-up that slows uptake.
liMeliGhT Ph3 topline (Q1 2027). We would cut if the low-luminance visual acuity gain misses, which would end the program.

filings.headline: IN THE COURT OF CHANCERY OF THE STATE OF DELAWARE PRESTON WEEMS, Plaintiff, v. OCUGEN, INC., Defendant. C.A. No. 2025-1214-NAC STIPULATION AND [PROPOSED] ORDER CLOSING THE CASE WHEREAS, on October 23,

rows.wrong_if: ZENITH alopecia areata Ph3 start (Dec 2026); AD Ph3 topline mid-2028. Our view changes if Ph3 maintenance data show responses fading off-drug, which would make REZPEG just another injectable.
Pre-BLA meeting (Q4 2026), BLA submission (Q1 2027); sura-vec wet AMD pivotal topline (Q4 2026). We would cut if FDA rejects external-control functional data or a liver-safety signal appears.
We would cover if Ph1 shows dose-dependent calcium increases with a once-daily oral profile.
We would cover if early responses are competitive with ivonescimab's and a partner signs.
We would cover if responses approach enfortumab vedotin's ~52% with manageable kidney and marrow toxicity.
We would cover if Cohort 2 confirms histologic protection with a larger effect.
We would cover if a partner pays meaningfully for the brain-carrier platform.
